items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Seems to me he was probably with Sam Morgan then... He and Jim Crow would have been playing with Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: Will he playin' drum go? Let me see. Jim Crow. Jim Crow. Let me see what Jim Crow. No, no. Jim Crow. I don't know. I just remember now. Was it Sonny Henry with the. No, this fellow was playing the bass with Sadie, Chinese, Buddy PT. But now. Did he have a banjo player? Johnny, yeah. We didn't see there. No, Johnny. Yeah, that's with Johnny, Johnny, David. You were in that band? No, Johnny was on the boat. Yeah, but Johnny, wait, I'm trying to get that together now. No, Johnny wasn't with them, no.

Seems to me he was probably with Sam Morgan then. I'm trying to remember now. About that time. He and Jim Crow would have been playing with Sam Morgan. Yeah. And uh, did you ever know George Washington?
Yeah. I believe it was his name, George Washington. Did he play bass?
